newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Heavy rains in Philippines delay copra harvest.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rains in Philippines delay copra harvest.

text.p: Heavy rains in parts of the southern Philippine island of Mindanao are delaying the harvest of copra, traders said on Monday.
"Although there is no damage to the crop we have been having rains for the past two weeks and these delay copra harvest," one trader told Reuters.
"We need a longer period of sunshine to dry the coconut meat. Moisture level should be down to 6.0 percent before we can make any sale," he added.
Mindanao accounts for 30 to 35 percent of the country's supply of coconut. Copra-rich provinces experiencing persistent rains are Cotabato, Lanao del Norte and General Santos.
Traders said coconut oil prices will move in a narrow range with an upward bias this week due to copra harvest delays.
